provenance: Original procedural mesh assemblies and deterministic pixel clusters authored from the selected Act2 shape/material references. No stock pixels, concept-board crops, board atlas cells, captions or source quotations are imported.

api.build: static build(parent: Node3D) -> Dictionary: creates own HorsellHeathKit root and returns root, witnesses:Array[Node3D], eruption:Node3D
api.set_tableau: static set_tableau(kit: Dictionary, state: String, progress: float = 0.0) -> void: existing witness roots/retreat translation with derived watch, turn, two retreat-step textures and empty visibility
api.set_eruption: static set_eruption(kit: Dictionary, visible: bool, normalized_progress: float = 0.0) -> void: independent rise/expansion/fade pose
api.ownership: Root level owns state clocks, snapshot fields, transitions, terrain collision and cleanup. queue_free of root releases nodes/local material clones; immutable cached resources remain reusable.

resource_policy.deterministic_generation: Integer cluster/hash formulas and fixed hand-authored pixel strokes; no randomize, RNG stream, wall clock or frame-rate-dependent generation
resource_policy.caching: Static mesh/texture/material dictionaries reuse immutable resources; witness48x64 textures cached by costume variant + pose (four per costume maximum). Surface UV variants cached by kind/size. Only six eruption-owned material clones change alpha.
generated_geometry_families: box by size for architectural parts only
resource_policy.gameplay_systems: none; no colliders, Area3D, bodies, actor AI, player/camera/HUD, scheduler, danger geometry, equipment or ability state

technical_research.observation: Material ALPHA supports normal depth transparency in Compatibility; instance transparency is unsupported there. Camera projections/rays and positive-area hull intersections identify actual foreground obstruction.
